description: Next.js framework pack: route files and conventions that must never be flagged dead.
notes: Files under pages/ and app/ are routes resolved by the framework, not by imports. middleware.ts and proxy.ts (Next.js 15.2+ renames middleware to proxy) are framework entry points at ANY depth — e.g. docker/proxy.ts — not just the repo root, and their default-exported middleware function and config.matcher are framework-resolved.
